ideas.name: VIX and Realized Volatility Filter
ideas.claim: Invest in a leveraged S&P 500 ETF when average VIX exceeds realized SPY volatility; otherwise remain out of the market.
ideas.quote: Specifically, when the average VIX value (implied volatility) exceeds SPY’s annualized X-day standard deviation (realized volatility), we take this as a signal to invest in SPXL.

rules.market: SPXL; signals use SPY and VIX
rules.entry: Invest in SPXL when the 60-day average VIX exceeds the annualized 10-day standard deviation of SPY returns.
rules.exit: Hold each position for one day and repeat the procedure.
rules.filters: VIX is available with a one-day lag.

ideas.claimed_result: For the initial 60-day VIX and 10-day SPY volatility parameters, the page reports returns double those of its SPY benchmark over the stated backtest period.
